'''Rawk's Nest''' was a series of buildings on [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] inhabited by [[Rawk|"Bantha" Rawk]] and his family. In [[137 ABY]] the Nest came [[Skirmish on Iego|under attack]] by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], trying to force "Bantha" Rawk to pay protection money. He refused and a fight ensued. "Bantha" Rawk, together with his wife [[Droo Rawk|Droo]] and their adoptive children [[Ahnah Rawk|Ahnah]], [[Skeeto Rawk|Skeeto]] and [[Micah (Cathar)|Micah]], and the help of the crew of the [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']] managed to defeat the Black Sun enforcers.
